explanation: Joining user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id names one session, and a pair with a missing part becomes missing, which COUNT skips. Counting distinct ga_session_id values alone is the tempting slip: it is the second a session started, so two visitors who start in the same second count as one. Counting every session_start row keeps the visitors who denied consent, and dashed dates never match the text in event_date.
